title: Build Hour: Workspace agents in ChatGPT
description:
Build workspace agents in ChatGPT that can do work across your tools and help teams move faster. In this Build Hour, you’ll learn how to turn your team’s best practices into shared agents from start to finish.

Christina Huang (Engineering), Ho Joon Cha (Solutions Engineering), and Victoria Chernova (Product Marketing) cover: 
• How to build agents for common workflows that require multiple steps, tools, and sources of context 
• Using agent builder chat, choosing tools and connectors, and adding guardrails
• Testing, iterating, and sharing agents powered by Codex in the cloud
• Best practices and live Q&A

segments.heading: Core Architecture and Technical Motivations for Build Hour: Workspace agents in ChatGPT
segments.text: In this session on Build Hour: Workspace agents in ChatGPT, Victoria, Christina, Hojun, OpenAI Workspace Team examine the underlying architectural principles and operational requirements shaping frontier AI systems. The presentation highlights how modern engineering teams leverage OpenAI, ChatGPT Enterprise, Workspace Agents to address foundational challenges in AI Agents, Product/Startup. Rather than relying on rigid heuristic pipelines, the architecture emphasizes end-to-end model legibility, structured context windows, and robust feedback loops. Participants explore how these patterns eliminate brittle manual glue code, providing a resilient platform capable of maintaining accuracy even under intense compute constraints and rapid requirement iteration.

segments.heading: Implementation Mechanics, System Workflows, and Tool Integrations
segments.text: Diving into technical mechanics, the speakers demonstrate concrete implementation workflows using OpenAI, ChatGPT Enterprise, Workspace Agents. Key engineering workflows center on deterministic execution pipelines, rigorous schema validation, and low-latency data flow. By decomposing complex objectives into auditable intermediate states, developers can reliably track token expenditures, isolate runtime anomalies, and enforce strict execution boundaries. The session walks through hands-on architectures where automated orchestration safely manages high-concurrency requests, external API calls, and persistent state stores.

segments.heading: Operational Deployment, Evaluation Benchmarks, and Future Trajectory
segments.text: The concluding segment addresses enterprise deployment standards, cost efficiency trade-offs, and empirical evaluation benchmarks. Speakers present metrics for assessing reliability in production environments, emphasizing continuous evaluation against realistic task distributions. Organizations deploying OpenAI, ChatGPT Enterprise, Workspace Agents must balance inference latency with reasoning depth, ensuring that guardrails and safety invariants remain intact throughout system lifecycle. Looking ahead, the discussion outlines upcoming platform milestones and strategic paradigms for scaling autonomous, high-integrity AI workloads across diverse industry domains.
